title: Five books
logline: Thursday. Wood sorts the floor into stacks. Five. Five hundred pages of five different books, none past page a hundred. The strip draws the stacks and the dog choosing one.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD on his knees sorting pages into stacks. BARNABY watching. Five stacks forming.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man on his knees on a garage floor sorting typed pages into five separate stacks, a small dog watching

panels.composition: The stacks, labeled with offcuts: THE RIDGE · THE FERRY · SLASH (2001) · THE LOT · untitled. Each a hundred pages at most.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of five stacks of typed pages each with a small hand-lettered label on a scrap of mat board
image.notes: Letter after: THE RIDGE · THE FERRY · SLASH (2001) · THE LOT · (untitled). Five books; none finished.

panels.composition: The dog walking the stacks. Sniffing each. Lying down on THE RIDGE.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small dog inspecting five stacks of paper and lying down on one of them

panels.composition: Wood looking at the dog on the stack. Then at the stack. The strip, without saying so, has picked the one that goes on the wall in 2006.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man looking at a small dog lying on a stack of pages and accepting the choice

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Five books, none finished. The dog picks THE RIDGE. (See dw_2006-11-07, dw_2006-11-24.)
